original_test_intent: Close exactly one owner-approved isolated BMC session by verified ID and prove it is no longer usable without terminating any other session.
original_method: Retain App 0x06/0x3C and source byte-order example; constrain execution to one selected in-band or OOB path with explicit ownership and independent verification.
manual_activity: Owner identifies the isolated target session, selects one closure path, approves termination and defines an independent post-close check.
required_inputs: Exact 32-bit session ID and byte order
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials/session IDs beyond policy
Do not use SOL activation merely to discover an arbitrary ID
agent_execution_scope: Encode four bytes LSB-first as specified
Verify only target session is absent/unusable
engineer_actions: Notify owner if selection ambiguity occurs

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek withholding is safer than blind execution but misses the identifiable standard command and source's ownership/path hazards.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After explicit approval, issue one `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x3c <id-byte0> <id-byte1> <id-byte2> <id-byte3>` through the selected safe path for the verified owned session.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Opcode, byte-order concept and 10/5 timing remain preserved; the example ID is never reused.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture an isolated session's identity from an authoritative fixture, close it once, and verify absence from a separate path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates ambiguous dual-path execution and SOL discovery while adding ownership and unaffected-session evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Listing or probing the session without closing it is not functional Close Session coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale or incorrectly endian-encoded ID can terminate another active management or SOL user.

project_override_considerations: A vendor session-delete API is equivalent only if it targets the identical session object and provides ownership plus post-close evidence; otherwise raw-path coverage remains open.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source mixes SOL-based creation, in-band closure and OOB closure without saying whether both are required or how the control session differs from the target; this creates unsafe ambiguous coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Close-session semantics are clear. Ownership, ID, path and verification are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes termination precisely scoped, eliminates dual-close/unknown-ID behavior and requires proof that only the intended session ended.
independent_technical_reasoning: A session ID is transient and little-endian byte transcription is not sufficient proof of ownership. Closing through the same connection used for control can also destroy the verification path. The testcase therefore needs an independently identified session and a distinct observer before one irreversible termination request.
